channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: Ritabrata-led TMC camp names candidates for Bengal bypolls
item.description: Mohammad Eteshamul Haque will contest from Nandigram in Purba Medinipur district as the rebel TMC candidate, while Safiuzzaman Sheikh has been nominated from Rejinagar in Murshidabad

item.title: U.P. Congress seeks one-time relief for State teacher recruitment exam candidates over new eligibility rules
item.description: U.P. Congress chief Ajay Rai writes to CM Yogi Adityanath based on a representation of demands received from Trained Graduate Teachers (TGT), Post Graduate Teachers (PGT) 2026 candidates

item.title: Intensify protest over land acquisition: Rakesh Tikait urges Noida farmers
item.description: The Bharatiya Kisan Union (BKU) national spokesperson alleged that the administration was preventing farmers from holding protests and meeting officials; farmers have been seeking developed residential plots and enhanced compensation for land acquired for development projects

item.title: Govt. bars bank charges on payments up to ₹2,000 via UPI, RuPay-powered debit cards
item.description: The government notified changes ‌in the Payment And ​Settlement ⁠Act, 2007

item.title: DBT transfer to 1,200 beneficiaries, 22 milk cooperatives handed registration certificates in U.P. dairy conclave
item.description: A dairy conclave of the three divisions was held in Jhansi on September 11 with theme of women participation and entrepreneurship in dairy development

item.title: Kerala HC issues notice to Mani C. Kappan on petition seeking disqualification as Pala MLA
item.description: The matter will be considered again on September 22

item.title: Jarange-Patil vows to take Maratha quota fight to Mumbai; 10 people, two ambulances to accompany him on Sept. 15
item.description: Chief Minister Fadnavis urged the activist to reconsider his plan to stage a protest in Mumbai in view of the ongoing Ganesh festival

item.title: Underwater survey to be done to assess long-term impact of MSC Elsa 3 sinking, Centre informs Kerala HC
item.description: The Liberian-flagged vessel owned by the Mediterranean Shipping Company (MSC) sank off the coast of Alappuzha in May 2025, reportedly causing substantial coastal and marine damage to the shores of Keralam and Tamil Nadu

item.title: BJP wins Kota municipal elections, poll for chairperson postponed after EVM glitches in some wards
item.description: Re-polling has been scheduled on September 16 in the affected booths prior to finalising the local body election outcomes, with counting on September 17

item.title: DJ system seized, case booked against Ganesh pandal organisers in Adilabad for violating orders
Upgraded Karimnagar-Warangal section of NH 563 set to boost tourism, trade in the region
item.description: The upgrade is expected to reduce the travel distance by around 11 km and bring down the journey time from about 90 minutes to nearly 50 minutes

item.title: Rain brings relief to farmers in Telangana’s Karimnagar
item.description: Overnight rain caused waterlogging in Kothagattu, Gollapalli and neighbouring villages in Shankarapatnam mandal

item.title: Rajasthan urban local body poll results: Victory of truth over echo of falsehood, PM Modi says
item.description: The BJP emerged ahead of the Congress in Rajasthan's urban local body elections, winning 4,179 wards against the opposition party's 3,613 and securing clear majorities in four of 10 municipal corporations

item.title: Tamil Nadu CB-CID nabs Rajasthan scammer who circulated Al-generated deep fake video impersonating CM Vijay
item.description: The accused and his associates used AI-generated deep fake videos asking the general public to contact a WhatsApp number for any financial help, police said

item.title: CJI says judiciary cannot earn public trust by shielding itself from scrutiny
item.description: “A court cannot seek the confidence of the public by placing itself beyond scrutiny; it must remain willing to be examined, questioned and, where necessary, criticised,” the Chief Justice said.

item.title: Rajasthan Urban Local Body polls results: BJP secures 4 of 10 municipal corporations; Congress blames ‘unfair’ delimitation
item.description: The Congress secured majority in Bikaner Municipal Corporation and scored a major victory in Municipal Council in Jhalawar, considered a stronghold of former chief minister Vasundhara Raje.

item.title: 17 of 20 NCPI MPs to likely to join BJP, says MP Jagadish Basunia
item.description: Cooch Behar MP Jagdish Chandra Barma Basunia said that three MPs Abu Taher Khan, Khalilur Rahman and Yusuf Pathan will support the ruling NDA even if they do not join the BJP directly

item.title: Kerala HC grants police protection to journalist Aparna Kurup following cyberattacks over TV Debate involving Kanthapuram’s remarks
item.description: Ms. Kurup had approached the court following alleged cyber attacks and death threats arising from a TV program she had hosted debating the remarks made by Sunni Muslim Scholar Kanthapuram A.P. Aboobacker Musaliyar about women

item.title: Ideological clarity may soon be just a tap away for CPI(M) cadre in Keralam
item.description: Launching of web/mobile applications to clear doubts among the suggestions put forward by delegates at the extended State committee meeting in Kozhikode

item.title: Maharashtra govt. orders probe into land transfer to Premier Automobiles over six decades ago
item.description: Following allegations of cattle-grazing land allotted for industrial purpose in 1960s turning into premium real estate in alleged land use violation, the Maharashtra Revenue Department has constituted a nine-member Special Investigation Team (SIT), headed by the Konkan Divisional Commissioner

item.title: Tamil Nadu government signs slew of MoUs during CM Vijay’s London visit to attract investment, create high-value jobs
item.description: According to an official release, this investment will create employment opportunities for around 7,000 people across sectors including design, engineering, manufacturing, assembly and logistics facilities

item.title: Satheesan, Anwar Ibrahim discuss investment opportunities in Keralam
item.description: The meeting focused on expanding cooperation between Keralam and Malaysia in healthcare, tourism, trade, investment and education, and on identifying opportunities for Malaysian investment in the State.

item.title: Rift within NDA over implementation of UCC in Bihar
item.description: Ruling JD (U) MLA and former Minister Shyam Rajak said that UCC will not be implemented in Bihar at any cost

item.title: Former DUTA chief Aditya Narayan Mishra joins Congress, flags ‘crisis’ in education
item.description: Mr. Mishra joined the party in the presence of Delhi Congress in-charge Qazi Nizamuddin, Delhi Pradesh Congress Committee president Devender Yadav, AICC Uttar Pradesh in-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam and other party leaders

item.title: Time to take forward ties ‘without backsliding’, says China’s Foreign Minister
item.description: Quoting Mr. Xi, Foreign Minister Wang Yi said, “under the strategic guidance of the two countries’ leaders, China-India relations have gradually emerged from a low point, progressing from a ‘restart’ to a ‘renewed height.’

item.title: Telangana Minister offers support to family of deceased BRS leader
item.description: Minister Adluri Lakshman Kumar extends helping hand to family of former BRS mandal president; provides ₹50,000 assistance and assures outsourcing job for widow

item.title: Backward Classes group raises concern over challenges to caste census
item.description: National BC Dal president Dundra Kumaraswamy said variations arising from regional nomenclature, sub-caste identities, local usage, pronunciation and spelling could result in multiple entries for what may, in social terms, represent the same community

item.title: India approves expedited export of electricity to flood-hit Nepal
item.description: “The approval will help Nepal meet its power requirements during this difficult period and further strengthen the close and longstanding energy cooperation between India and Nepal,” stated India’s Power Ministry.

item.title: Dalits counter BJP protest in T. Narsipur over Ganesha procession
item.description: Dalit groups accuse former MP Pratap Simha of deliberately spreading communal poison in T. Narsipur with his allegedly inflammatory statements

item.title: Three bonded labourers rescued at Kalasthambadi in Tiruvannamalai district
item.description: K. Viji, 25, his wife V. Sasikala, 23, and his brother K. Surya, 19, were forced to stay in small huts without proper access to drinking water and toilets and made to work for more than 15 hours a day

item.title: Vijay meets Ajith Kumar: 4 memorable times the Tamil stars met in the past
item.description: Former actor and Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay’s meeting with actor and racer Ajith Kumar on the sidelines of the Michelin Le Mans Cup at Silverstone in the UK has taken the Internet by storm

item.title: ‘Power House’ is Vikram’s next with Anand Shankar; title teaser out
item.description: ‘Power House’, previously called ‘Chiyaan 63’, will release in 2027

item.title: Central team to visit Bihar on September 16 to assess flood damage
item.description: According to the latest figures from the Bihar Disaster Management Department (DMD), the floods affected over 49.36 lakh people in 88 blocks across 15 districts

item.title: Farmers start dharna outside Punjab Minister’s office in Hoshiarpur
item.description: The call for the sit-in outside the residences and offices of several ministers in Punjab was given by the KMM on a 12-point charter of demands, including loan waiver and withdrawal of cases registered against those who participated in agitations by farmers and workers.

item.title: West Bengal bypolls: TMC MP urges EC to ensure no eligible voter denied voting right
item.description: Nearly 25 lakh appeals have been filed before SIR tribunals over deletion of names from the voter list

item.title: BJP candidate gets one vote in Rajasthan local body polls
item.description: Mr. Kailashchand said that he was a voter of Ward 12 but the BJP fielded him from the neighbouring Ward 13 of the Parbatsar municipality in Didwana-Kuchaman district

item.title: Three main accused in Goa nightclub fire surrender before Mapusa court two weeks after SC order
item.description: The fatal fire at the Birch by Romeo Lane nightclub in Arpora, North Goa, on December 6, 2025, claimed 25 lives and left several others injured

item.title: Amit Shah stresses cultural nationalism, promotion of Indian languages at Rajbhasha event
item.description: All political differences must be set aside to promote Indian languages,” Amit Shah said while asserting that a child can understand the country only through his or her mother tongue

item.title: Gurugram woman biker injured in hit-and-run; accused identified, police launch suo motu probe
item.description: The rider alleged that the car had been chasing her before hitting her Aprilia RS 457 and fleeing the spot; the collision was captured on her motorcycle-mounted camera and the bike was sent sliding

item.title: Kashmiri Pandits mark Balidan Diwas in Jammu; reiterate ‘genocide’ recognition, homeland demands
item.description: The community reiterated its demand for legal recognition of the violence against and displacement of Kashmiri Pandits as "genocide" and called for the establishment of a separate homeland in the Valley under direct Union protection

item.title: Owaisi slams Shah’s UCC remark, asks if NDA allies have ‘independent voice’
Residents take out protest following drinking water shortage in Kochi
item.description: Sources at KWA said that the issue has come to their notice and will be rectified soon

item.title: Religious fervour, creativity, colossal offerings mark Vinayaka Chaturthi celebration in Tamil Nadu
item.description: In Madurai, the spotlight fell on the colossal 7-foot monolithic Mukkuruni Vinayakar inside the renowned Sri Meenakshi Sundareshwar Temple

item.title: In Pictures: Ganesh Chaturthi 2026
item.description: Ganesh Chaturthi is being celebrated in grandeur in various parts of the country on September 13, 2026

item.title: Justice V. Kameswar Rao takes oath as Chief Justice of Patna High Court
item.description: The oath-taking ceremony at the Lok Bhavan was attended by Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary and other dignitaries

item.title: ‘PM says sab changa si, but sab mehenga si’ Congress on WPI inflation
item.description: To compound the misery, according to CMIE data, inflation-adjusted wages have also been consistently falling with a 5.7% drop since April, Jairam Ramesh said

item.title: Supreme Court announces launch of Hindi public information service ‘Jan Soochna Seva’
item.description: The service will be initially launched in Hindi, and work will soon be undertaken to make it available in other Indian languages ​​in a phased manner

item.title: Tamil Nadu Minister S. Ramesh says ‘obscene, derogatory’ remarks are DMK’s DNA
item.description: Addressing reporters, the minister acknowledged that staging protests and demonstrations is a fundamental democratic right, but strongly condemned the use of foul language during political events

item.title: India gains wider EU steel access, but carbon levy remains
item.description: The agreement provides India with an additional preferential quota of 694,853 ‌tons of steel, on top ‌of ⁠an existing 946,616 ton WTO quota.

item.title: Ganesh Chaturthi celebrations begin with fervour across Telangana
item.description: Lakhs of Lord Ganesha idols of various sizes and forms were installed at homes, apartment complexes and road corners for worship in Hyderabad and all other towns and villages in the State

item.title: Kochi Metro documents leak: Police launch probe
item.description: According to police, the incident came to light after KMRL found that some of its confidential documents were being circulated in WhatsApp groups

item.title: Retired IAF officer assaulted at a commercial complex in Gurugram
item.description: The incident took place on the evening of September 10 and the accused has been identified as parking staff of the complex

item.title: Bihari youth arrested for alleged murder of colleague from the State in Kochi plywood factory
item.description: The arrested person is Mohammed Sahil, 23, of Muzaffarpur in Bihar; he has been charged with murder

item.title: One baby orangutan develops fever at Odisha's Nandankanan Zoo, under treatment
item.description: One of the orangutans has had a fever since the day it was brought here; the fever subsides when given medicine, but reappears again; but it is now stable and under strict medical supervision, a senior official said

item.title: Former Tehelka editor Tarun Tejpal surrenders before Goa Court; sent to jail to serve 10-year sentence
item.description: On August 25, the Supreme Court had directed Tejpal to surrender within three weeks to undergo his 10-year prison sentence following his conviction by the Bombay High Court

item.title: Exhibitors upbeat as rom-com, content-driven movies helping Mollywood to make it big at box-office
item.description: Filmmaker A. D Girish’s Bethlehem Kudumba Unit, featuring Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju in lead roles, has crossed the 300-crore mark in worldwide collections

item.title: India, Canada begin next round of talks on proposed trade pact: Official
item.description: The negotiations are important as the two sides have targeted to increase bilateral trade to $50 billion by 2030.

item.title: Asia Cup 2026: Indian women’s cricket team refuse trophy from Pakistan’s Mohsin Naqvi
item.description: Indian women’s cricket team did not accept the cup from Mohsin Naqvi, the Asian Cricket Council (ACC) chairperson from Pakistan.

item.title: Army-backed flag centre empowers 140 women in Kashmir’s Kupwara
item.description: The society has 12 skill development centres where 140 women are employed from various parts of Kupwara, a senior army officer said

item.title: Meta restricts access to viral AI video of Keralam CM dancing over power cuts
item.description: ‘We have restricted access to your content in India pursuant to notice from the Government of India’, a message from Meta shared by the creators said
